reserveReview.rationale: Pinned Base block 52630636 (2026-10-15T07:50:19Z; hash 0xd29b0a40afb66cf6503e9627bbb4546f867c64172fb6f01822879425dc73b8a5). totalAssets()=476165762076098 USDC base units, totalSupply()=439882075988993114685529010, lostAssets()=0. Complete three-entry supply/withdraw queues retain cbBTC market 0x9103c3b4e834476c9a62ea009ba2c884ee42e94e6e314a26f04d312434191836, WETH market 0x8793cf302b8ffd655ab97bd1c695dbd967807e8367a65cb2f4edaf1380ba1bda and collateral-free market 0x38c846197ac32a752a60c25d4536ebb0c3920c532e9a859c38c91efb7b8c2abb. cbBTC holds the entire accounted USDC claim; WETH has 614313 supply shares that round to zero asset base units, and the collateral-free position is zero. Borrow shares and collateral are zero in all three vault positions. The 49154985 idle USDC base units are donated assets excluded by MetaMorphoV1_1 totalAssets() and its ordinary market-withdrawal path; they are not an immediate holder reserve slice. This corrects the old idle-plus-receivable denominator. These are protocol receivables, not directly held borrower cbBTC or independent financial assurance.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete immutable MetaMorphoV1_1 accounted-NAV denominator; donated idle USDC excluded, lostAssets separately checked at zero
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved composition-link dispositions remain within the immediate position accounting denominator. This does not establish stressed realization, enforceable priority or independently reconciled ultimate backing; those protections remain unproven. Underlying issuer and protocol risk remains serial, and whole-book custody uncertainty is recorded separately in custodyProfile.

This establishes heterogeneous custody layers and supports the mixed whole-book label, not a direct holder claim against Coinbase.
